annotations.title: Get and verify an OMNIGATE Runtime receipt

description: OMNIGATE Runtime receipt (FREE). Returns a run receipt — script sha256, payer, rail, payment tx, every upstream call with request/response hashes and charges, outcome — signed with Ed25519 and hash-chained to the previous receipt, plus a verification of signature, body hash and chain link. Use it to prove what an agent ran and paid for.

receipt_id.description: Receipt id from a runtime run (rcpt_…).

name: omnigate_runtime_receipt
